Class AnswerRepository

java.lang.Object
Database.Repositories.AnswerRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Database.Repositories.Interfaces.IAnswerRepository
public class AnswerRepository extends Object implements Database.Repositories.Interfaces.IAnswerRepository
The AnswerRepository class provides database operations for Answer objects. It implements CRUD functionality (create, read, update, delete) and helper methods to interact with the answers table in the database.
